findings.note: This page has no 2026-27 news; its latest Rotowire note (Apr 12, 2026) says Monahan had a 19-game goal drought and an 11-game point drought that pushed him to the fourth line under interim coach Rick Bowness, and he finished 2025-26 with 23 assists in 76 games.
This older 2024-25 summary says Monahan had 38 assists in 54 games and led the NHL in 5-on-5 assists per 60 minutes; it shows his best-case playmaking level but is not current-season evidence.
